camera.description: The configured camera to show. The dropdown lists the gateway's cameras; any name or binding works.

mode.description: live, or playback of recordings at playbackTime. The component's own Live / back-30s / timeline controls write this.

playbackTime.description: Playback position (epoch ms). Written back about once a second while playing; writing it seeks.

quality.description: The size to show: auto (the camera's own stream, transcoded only when this browser cannot decode it), or a transcode profile from Camera Settings (e.g. 720p). The dropdown lists the profiles. Applies to live video and playback. Also accepted: main, sub, or custom (the size and bitrate in customQuality).

customQuality.description: Used when quality is custom: the video is transcoded to this height and bitrate.

height.description: Height in pixels, 120-2160; never above the camera's own.

transport.description: Live video transport. auto uses the gateway's default; hls is low-latency HLS through the gateway's own port (about 1-2 s behind); webrtc is about 0.2-0.5 s behind but needs the media port reachable, and falls back to HLS when it is not.

muted.description: Mute audio. Browsers block autoplay with sound, so unmuting needs a user gesture.

showStatus.description: Show the camera name and connection state overlay.

showControls.description: Show Live / back-30s / play / speed / range controls.

showTimeline.description: Show the recording timeline under the video.

allowBookmarks.description: Show the bookmark (★) button. Bookmarks are attributed to the session user.
